title: Jo Maler Mag Nyasaye
stanzas: Jo maler mag Nyasaye, e wachne maler Oketonu mise madier mar genruok;
Jogo maringo ir Yesu ma Jawar,
"Kik iluor, an kodi, chunyi kik oa; An ma Nyasachi, pod ayie konyoi;
Kipadori kuoma, lueta nosiri. Kipadori kuoma, lueta nosiri."
"Kata kikadho e masira malich, Kata kuyo mapek ok noneg chunyi;
Hapa nobed kodi e chandruok malit. Hapa nobed kodi e chandruok malit."
"Ka Satan otemi gi temruok mager, Ng`wonona oromi; namiyi loyo;
Kuom temruok magerno machalo gi mach,
Adwaro pwodhi mond` ibed maler chuth."
